findings.issue: Common nouns (definite singular) are left as untranslated Hebrew-shaped words instead of Spanish common nouns.
findings.spanishSpan: kos y el shalaj y el yanshuf

findings.issue: Each וְאֶת contributes ו as y; the direct-object marker is not lexicalized. Grammatical smoothing with no added participant or concept.

notes: Articles and conjunctions match; the three common-noun heads are transliterated.
